about: BayCounty.me Savings finder: places Bay County governments could spend less, each with the records it rests on, an illustrative estimate and its assumption. An opportunity is a question worth asking, not a finding that money was wasted.

opportunities.title: Clear utility conflicts before Front Beach Road Segment 4
opportunities.basis: Both finished Front Beach Road segments ended above their first firm figure, and Segment 3 ran about a year late because of utility conflicts and a storm drain redesign. Segments 4.1, 4.2 and 4.3 are almost entirely still ahead.
opportunities.assumption: Mapping underground utilities and signing utility agreements before construction trims the cost still ahead on Segment 4.
opportunities.next_step: Ask the city to fund subsurface utility mapping and utility agreements before the Segment 4.1 design-build award.
opportunities.in_play_is: cost still ahead on Segments 4.1 to 4.3

groups.note: The final figure is the whole project cost (design, land and construction); the first is the construction award or low bid.

opportunities.title: Recover or commit idle CRA money
opportunities.basis: Callaway's and Springfield's CRAs spent a small share of their FY2025 capital budgets. Money a CRA neither spends nor commits to a project can be questioned by the governments that pay into it.
opportunities.assumption: The low end assumes all of it is already committed to projects; the high end assumes every unspent dollar goes back to the taxing authorities.
opportunities.next_step: Confirm Florida's rule on unspent tax increment, and ask each CRA which project each year-end balance is committed to.

opportunities.title: Bundle and benchmark Front Beach Road engineering
opportunities.basis: Front Beach Road design and construction administration is bought through a string of task orders, and utility relocation design was bought separately from roadway design on Segments 4.1 and 4.2. The CRA's program manager has also changed several times.
opportunities.assumption: Bundling related design work and benchmarking fees against FDOT norms lowers the fees.
opportunities.next_step: Compare design fees as a share of construction cost against FDOT norms, and price an in-house CRA engineer or program manager against continued task orders.
opportunities.in_play_is: Front Beach Road engineering task orders

requests.q: The program management and engineering contracts for the Front Beach Road CRA (Corradino, DRMP and others), with fees paid by year, and the fee schedule under the 2018 Dewberry master services agreement

opportunities.title: Bid Panama City CRA paving with the county
opportunities.basis: The Panama City CRA approved several years of road resurfacing across three districts in March 2026, on a split vote.
opportunities.assumption: Buying at the county's paving unit prices, or bidding together, costs less than buying alone.
opportunities.next_step: Ask whether the county's paving unit prices can be used through an interlocal agreement or a piggyback contract.

requests.q: The unit prices in Bay County's current road resurfacing contract, and whether the city can use them through an interlocal agreement

opportunities.title: One countywide plate-reader and camera contract
opportunities.basis: Panama City's CRA bought a license plate reader program and a camera integration program, and Lynn Haven's CRA pays its police department to lease plate readers. Each agency buys its own.
opportunities.assumption: One shared contract for plate readers and cameras costs less per unit than separate purchases.
opportunities.next_step: List every plate-reader and camera contract in the county, including the Sheriff's Office, with unit counts and annual costs.

requests.q: The license plate reader and camera contracts paid by the CRA, with vendor, number of units and annual cost
The license plate reader lease paid with CRA aid to the police department, with vendor, number of units and annual cost

opportunities.title: Rebid Front Beach Road landscape maintenance
opportunities.basis: The Front Beach Road CRA's landscape maintenance contract was awarded in 2020 and is paid every year.
opportunities.assumption: A rebid against current per-acre rates lowers the annual cost.
opportunities.next_step: Check the contract term and renewal history, and benchmark per-acre maintenance rates.

requests.q: The Front Beach Road CRA landscape maintenance contract with Rotolo Consultants, its renewals, and payments by year

opportunities.title: Review the Front Beach Road CRA bonds for refunding
opportunities.basis: The Front Beach Road CRA carries Series 2015 and Series 2020 bonds. The original FY2025 budget also carried interest on 2024 bonds that the amended budget removed, so it is not clear whether those bonds were issued before the money was needed.
opportunities.next_step: Get the official statements (coupons and call dates) and run a refunding analysis once the bonds can be called.
opportunities.in_play_is: a year of CRA debt service (FY2024 amended budget)

requests.q: The official statements for the Front Beach Road CRA Series 2015, 2020 and any 2024 revenue bonds, including coupons, call dates and the date and amount of any 2024 issue

opportunities.title: Compare Lynn Haven sidewalk costs per block
opportunities.basis: Recent Lynn Haven CRA sidewalk projects cost very different amounts per block. Drainage, driveways or ADA work may explain the gap, but the records don't say.
opportunities.next_step: Get the bid tabulations and linear footage for each project and compare cost per linear foot.

groups.note: Blocks are counted from the street limits in each record.

requests.q: The bid tabulations, linear footage and scope (drainage, driveways, ADA ramps) for the Minnesota Ave, W 7th St and Tennessee Ave CRA sidewalk projects

opportunities.title: Check a storefront grant reported twice
opportunities.basis: Two years of Lynn Haven CRA annual reports each show one storefront grant with the same private investment. It may be one grant reported twice, or a final payment.
opportunities.next_step: Request the storefront grant files for both years.

requests.q: The Storefront Assistance Program grant files for FY2021 and FY2022, including the approval, payments and the property

opportunities.title: Copy Panama City's grant leverage
opportunities.basis: On some Panama City CRA projects a state or partner grant paid most of the cost, and the CRA paid a small share. Other projects were paid mostly with CRA money. Chasing matching grants first stretches every CRA dollar.
opportunities.next_step: Before funding a project mostly with CRA money, check FDOT, Rebuild Florida and partner programs for a match.
